creator: Alexander Terp
description: Alex's chat note, 2026-09-10: "commit to take cards as arguments? or a flag for how many expected to commit". kan commit stages every changed file under .kan/, so when two agents share a checkout, one commits the other's half-made cards. It happened on 2026-10-25: in agent-engine, a triage session committing its cards found another session's untracked new card beside them and had to stage files by hand to leave it out. Wanted: kan commit <card>... to commit only the named cards (plus board config they changed), or --expect <n> to fail when the count of changed cards differs. Today it takes only -m.
title: Let kan commit target specific cards, or assert how many it expects
